[![CRAN version](https://img.shields.io/cran/v/ssrn.svg)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ssrn) [![Development version on r-universe](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Furibo.r-universe.dev%2Fapi%2Fpackages%2Fssrn&query=%24.Version&label=r-universe)](https://uribo.r-universe.dev/ssrn)

Implements scan statistics on railway networks to estimate high-risk routes of infectious disease transmission from passenger volume data; co-developed with Yuta Tanoue and Daisuke Yoneoka. Method described in [Biostatistics & Epidemiology](../../publications/items/2022-transit-network-scan.qmd). On [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ssrn); source on [GitHub](https://github.com/uribo/ssrn).
